phase: Illustrated finish and a lighter interactive model
note: Actual front, three-quarter, back and grip renders inspected. Selective colored contours and the corrected cyan halo edge improve the illustration match. The browser copy now batches 199 source mesh objects into 21 material groups without changing the editable master. Remaining: softer cuff gathers and more reference-like pillow grip.

journal.title: First assembled model: lighting correction needed
journal.notes: The complete original model renders and exports. Visual review found severe highlight clipping, one eye partly obscured by the fringe, and a cylindrical garment silhouette. The next pass corrects shading and opens both eyes before judging finer detail.

journal.title: Colors restored; both eyes readable
journal.notes: Bounded cel illumination restores the lavender hair and original cat print. Both eyes are visible. Close inspection reveals a hair-cap intersection in the forehead opening, an overly rounded collar, stiff shirt shaping, and insufficiently asymmetric back hair. These are the next geometry corrections.

journal.title: Five-view inspection: anatomy and garment fit
journal.notes: The face, proportions, and collar are closer. Side and back checks exposed overly sharp knee bends, thighs intersecting the shorts, visible sleeve-root gaps, and abrupt back-hair roots. The next pass rebuilds rounded knees and fits the shorts to the actual posed thighs.

journal.title: Rounded knees; fitted shorts
journal.notes: The legs retain matched segment lengths, the knee transitions are rounded in profile, and the thighs stay inside the shorts. Remaining priorities are the visible back-hair roots, side-scalp coverage, sleeve joins, and a softer pillow silhouette.

journal.title: R05 reviewed: hair and profile corrections next
journal.notes: Reviewed front, side, back, and face. The model is recognizable, with rounded equal-length legs and original clothing. Side-scalp gaps, abrupt back-hair roots, a squared collar, and stiff raised fingers remain visible.

journal.title: Crown-rooted hair and quieter expression
journal.notes: Reviewed actual front, side, and back renders. Back tresses now flow from the crown and the eyelids better match the quiet reference expression. The side forehead still escapes the scalp shell, and the collar became too scalloped; these need targeted geometry fixes, not a higher claimed score.

journal.title: Reconstructed proportions, hands and soft pajama details
journal.notes: Actual front, face, side and grip renders reviewed. Matched leg lengths and a higher knee line improve the pose; the original print and pocket have been rebuilt. Remaining defects: blunt side-hair endings, collar intersections, a wrist crease and underspecified slipper bows. This is a recovery checkpoint, not the 95/100 target.

journal.title: Continuous wrists, cleaned collar and folded slipper bows
journal.notes: Reviewed actual front, portrait, grip and slipper renders. The wrist cap crease is removed; the hair ends are pointed and the collar no longer intersects the shoulder patches. Slipper ribbons are real folded meshes. Remaining work: the raised-hand gesture, cloth drape, collar asymmetry, small toe-cap openings, and closer head proportions. The 95/100 target is not yet met.

journal.title: Refined pose, collar asymmetry and closed slippers
journal.notes: Reviewed actual front, back and three-quarter views. The elbow height and garment asymmetry are closer to the reference; slippers have closed toe caps, and both complete hand/arm meshes pass the one-component, closed-surface audit. Remaining priorities are the raised-hand silhouette, shirt/sleeve hem proportions, and softer transitions at the back-hair roots. Target 95/100 remains unmet.

journal.title: Fitted sewing details and curved shirt tails; neckline correction next
journal.notes: Reviewed front, portrait, back and raised-hand close-ups. The pocket and placket now follow the actual cloth mesh, shirt tails have a curved hem, and the back roots are less abrupt. The neckline shift exposed an unwanted blue shoulder-panel intrusion, and two fingers remain too close together. Score stays at 88; those are the next corrections, not reasons to claim 95.

journal.title: Shallow collar and clearer fingers; precise neckline seam next
journal.notes: Reviewed actual front, back and hand renders. Unified back-hair color removes the abrupt striping, and the finger paths are now separated. The wider opening fixes the blue neckline intrusion but leaves a narrow gap beneath the lapels. The next pass matches the shirt cut edge directly to that seam. Overall score remains 88.

journal.title: Sewn neckline, natural collar support and consistent side profile
journal.notes: Reviewed the front and side renders. The shirt cut edge now follows the underside of the lapels, removing both the blue intrusion and exposed seam gap. The pocket and placket remain fitted to the generated cloth. Remaining priorities are physical fingertip contact with the headband, cloth-fold shading, and finer illustrated hair definition. The visual target of 95 remains in progress.

journal.title: Recovered hand contact; verified five-view rebuild
journal.notes: Visually reviewed actual front, face, hand and side renders. The raised index now reaches the headband without elongating the wrist. Likeness still needs hair value separation, more expressive eyes, cloth definition and lapels that follow the torso in profile. Subjective visual review, not a certified benchmark.

journal.title: Hair and eyes improved; collar fit rejected
journal.notes: Actual front render reviewed at 89/100. The new hair values and eyes are retained in source, but the projected lapels intersect the skin. R25 remains the accepted live model until this defect is corrected.

journal.title: Body-aware collar fit and coherent hair depth
journal.notes: Front, face, side and back visually inspected. Skin clipping is removed and the lapels now follow the torso in profile. Hair transitions deepen toward the ends; eyes and cotton folds are clearer. All eight inspection images were rendered from R27. Remaining gaps: illustrative line definition, hair grouping, pillow drape and browser draw-call cost.

journal.title: Illustrated finish and a lighter interactive model
journal.notes: Actual front, three-quarter, back and grip renders inspected. Selective colored contours and the corrected cyan halo edge improve the illustration match. The browser copy now batches 199 source mesh objects into 21 material groups without changing the editable master. Remaining: softer cuff gathers and more reference-like pillow grip.

recoveryNote: R07–R17 were reviewed before an earlier Colab rollback but their images and source were lost. Retained-pass count includes only entries with preserved artifacts.
